description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed 
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it triggers
Holding priority, activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Izzet Boilerworks's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
